quotes.text: A first visit fix usually needs three things, the right person, clear instructions, and the correct part, and missing one can turn a simple repair into a second visit.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the three ingredients of a successful first-time fix.

quotes.text: Customer service can receive the call, but Field Service manages the trip, the work, the parts, and the result.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear distinction between customer service and field service.

quotes.text: An available person isn't always the right person. Field service can look for someone who can safely and correctly complete the work, not just someone with a blank slot on their calendar.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: That matters because the bill follows the work record rather than somebody retiping handwritten notes into another system.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the value of invoicing directly from the work order.

quotes.text: AI sorts through information quickly, but it can't visit the site. It can't assess a safety risk and it can't take responsibility for a customer promise.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A grounded view on the limits of AI in field work.

chapters.title: Copilot and the wider Microsoft connection

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Field Service manages on-site work from the first request through scheduling, the technician visit and parts to the final invoice.
The work order is the single source of facts for a visit, and the schedule board matches it to a resource with the right skills, availability and location.
The mobile app, customer assets and preventive or predictive maintenance improve first-visit fixes, while Copilot helps summarize but people stay responsible.
hook: Field service jobs often fall apart because of phone calls, paper notes and a technician who arrives without the right part. This episode explains Dynamics 365 Field Service in plain English for service managers, dispatchers and anyone planning on-site work. Follow one job from request to invoice and see how work orders, scheduling, the mobile app and assets fit together.
